english.title: Sex offenders register - parent fail ensure y/offender attend police station re notification - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the parent of a young offender under the age of 18, failed without reasonable excuse to ensure that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

attended at a police station, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STATION..), with you when the notification of **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE NOTIFICATION..), was being given and in compliance with section 89(2)(b) of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section91(1)(a) and (2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the parent of a young offender U18
who is subject to a parental direction under s.89 SOA
failed without reasonable excuse
to ensure that he/she
attended at a police station with you
when a notification was given
in compliance with s.89(2)(b)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording is OBSOLETE - a range of offence wordings have been consolidated at the request of the Magistrates Courts.
(ii) Now see offence wording CJS Code SX03204 - H5862 or CJS Code SX03205 - H5863.
(iii) The 'nature of the notification' required in the above wording refers to the same obligations as those imposed on an adult (see offence wordings H5825 to H5829, which are CJS codes SX03138 to SX03142 respectively)

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: Five years imprisonment

None
